brief.recommendation: Checkout at 0% success (BIZ-3) with $18,400/min revenue at risk. Waiting would cost ~$259,379 over 846s remaining runtime, far exceeding the 60s degradation tolerance (BIZ-4). Terminating the BATCH_REPLAYABLE blocker (may_interrupt policy, 6-min replay cost) releases locks immediately; historical precedent shows similar terminations restored checkout to 100% within 10s (MEM-1). No protected settlements (DB-2), no active change-calendar window (BIZ-5), registry data quality passes (BIZ-2).

audit.report: The batch_replayable_search_click_aggregate job (pid 1494311) went idle in transaction for 4.2s holding locks that blocked checkout, dropping success to 0% over 30s with $18,400/min revenue at risk. After two negotiation rounds (247.8s) the guardians agreed to terminate the blocker, but verification failed: a new instance (pid 1495241) of the same job immediately became the root blocker, checkout remained at 29% success, and 12 sessions still waited on locks. The business is not recovered; the incident is escalated.
audit.root_cause: The batch_replayable_search_click_aggregate job enters an idle-in-transaction state (last statement SELECT 1) that holds locks blocking checkout, and the scheduler restarts it immediately after termination so the blocking recurs.
lessons: For batch_replayable_search_click_aggregate: add a pre-check that the scheduler will not instantly respawn the job before proposing termination, or pause the job class via scheduler API during checkout degradation.

For batch_replayable_search_click_aggregate: investigate why the job sits idle in transaction with SELECT 1 — likely a connection pool or transaction boundary bug — and fix the application so it releases locks between batches.
audit.negotiation_critique: The continuity guardian correctly enforced Invariant I2 (missing change_calendar evidence) causing one revision round; this was necessary and not wasteful. The database guardian supplied complete evidence (locks, business impact, replay cost, memory precedent) in both proposals. No guardian missed evidence or was overridden by an invariant beyond the required I2 check.
follow_ups: Engineering: root-cause the idle-in-transaction SELECT 1 pattern in batch_replayable_search_click_aggregate and fix the transaction lifecycle.
Platform: add a scheduler pause/drain control for BATCH_REPLAYABLE jobs so termination during an incident is not immediately undone by a restart.
Process: extend the guardian memory to include change-calendar status for replayable batch jobs, eliminating the I2 probe round in future negotiations.
